newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin tells Russian women he loves them all.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin tells Russian women he loves them all.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin congratulated Russian women on Saturday, Women's Day, saying he loved them all and using the opportunity to snipe at the government and parliament.
"These are my words of love to you and I think (his wife) Naina Iosifovna will forgive me," the 66-year-old Russian leader said in a radio address.
"Russia is the country of immense riches but the biggest of all are you."
Women's Day is one of the most popular holidays in Russia.

Yeltsin used the oppurtunity to attack the government and parliament over the 1997 budget. He said last week he had major doubts the spending plan could be fulfilled but he had signed it to avoid political turmoil.

"By the way, when you try to resolve the problems of a family budget, you have to put more to it than our deputies or members of government, because, unlike them, you have to make a budget which can be fulfilled."
